question: To which beings and in which directions should the bali offering be given?
premises: An offering is to be given to the gaṇas.
The gaṇas receive it in the western part.
The yakṣas receive it in the northern part.
inference: The bali offering should be given to the gaṇas in the western part and to the yakṣas in the northern part.
plain_english: One should give the offering to the gaṇas in the western part and to the yakṣas in the northern part.
